title: Let Naam thin the inner dread
summary: Naam turns profit into inward fearlessness rather than more burden. Let Naam quiet the dread beneath wanting.
takeaway: Let Naam quiet the dread beneath wanting.
lifeApplication: Before the next defensive move, bring the breath back under one line of refuge and mercy.
